llm.summary: This is a mostly static Chinese home-renovation reference skill, but it includes broad and sometimes safety-sensitive renovation guidance beyond its door/window scope.

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no local filesystem, credential, network, or mutation authority. The main risk is advice quality and scope drift rather than agentic system access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install script, executable component, dependency fetch, remote payload, or tool-modifying behavior was found; the artifact is Markdown content plus Markdown references.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill tells the agent to answer in a specific Chinese renovation-advice voice and to use the reference corpus. It includes a general caution to verify non-load-bearing walls, property rules, and waterproofing, but several references contain prescriptive demolition, balcony, AC-platform, and waterproofing advice without equally consistent site-specific professional constraints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background worker, memory-writing, scheduled task, or tool-hijacking behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The declared purpose is door/window/sealing guidance, but the corpus includes broader renovation, formaldehyde-remediation, kitchen, old-home, balcony, and layout-modification material. Some adjacent balcony and sealing content is relevant, but the scope is broader than disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a Chinese-language renovation advice corpus and are comfortable with it covering more than doors and windows. Treat structural changes, balcony/AC-platform conversions, waterproofing, HVAC, air-quality, and demolition advice as high-level opinion only; verify with licensed professionals, local code, property management, and site-specific inspection before acting.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted in part: inspected references include formaldehyde, kitchen, old-home, and general renovation material that is broader than the declared door/window/sealing focus. This supports Review for scope clarity, not maliciousness.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Accepted in part: some references discuss wall demolition, AC outdoor-unit area conversions, balcony door removal, and waterproofing choices in a way that could be applied as actionable renovation guidance. The main SKILL.md adds some safety cautions, but the corpus is not consistently constrained.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: the artifact name, display name, description, and corpus are openly Chinese-language and regionally styled. This is a usability/localization note, not a material security concern by itself.
